cover_prompt: A vibrant, colorful children's book cover illustration for a farm animals coloring book. A cheerful farmyard scene with a big friendly cartoon cow in the center, surrounded by a happy pink pig, a yellow chicken, and a fluffy white sheep. A bright red barn in the background with a green rolling hill and a wooden fence. A smiling sun in a blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Professional children's book cover art style, bright eye-catching colors, cheerful and inviting cartoon composition. DO NOT include any text, letters, or words in the generated image.
